mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no, user_id, sku_id, activity_id, quantity, amount, status, request_id, created_at, updated_at FROM flash_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo}
SELECT id, order_no, user_id, sku_id, activity_id, quantity, amount, status, request_id, created_at, updated_at FROM flash_order WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, sku_id, activity_id, quantity, amount, status, request_id, created_at, updated_at FROM flash_order WHERE status IN ('INITIAL', 'PENDING_PAYMENT') AND created_at < #{expireTime} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, sku_id, activity_id, quantity, amount, status, request_id, created_at, updated_at FROM flash_order WHERE status = 'SHIPPED' AND created_at < #{expireTime} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
